preconditions.description: Number of vertices is within the specified range.
Number of edges is within the specified range.
Number of special vertices is within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= n for v_i in special_vertices)
preconditions.description: Special vertices are within the valid vertex range.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= c_i <= 10**9 for c_i in c_values)
preconditions.description: Coin values for vertices are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= w_i <= 10**9 for w_i in w_values)
preconditions.description: Coin costs for edges are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= n and 1 <= y_i <= n and x_i != y_i for x_i, y_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Edge endpoints are valid and distinct.
Number of edges matches the given count.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(profit, int) for profit in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= profit for profit in output)
